name: ChatGPT agent
desc: Agent mode that drives a browser and your connected apps.
desc_zh: 能自己开浏览器、用你账号干活的智能体模式。
solves: Booking, comparing, ordering, form-filling — all of it is clicking. It opens the browser and works through your own logged-in accounts.
solves_zh: 订票、比价、下单、填表，本质上都是点。它自己开浏览器，用你已登录的账号一步步做完。
best_for: A chain of online steps that would otherwise be twenty separate clicks.
best_for_zh: 那种本来要点二十多下的线上流程，交给它跑完。
